title: Memory-safe nonlinear coefficient and control-point learning

design.target: 3–7 coefficients of true suffix correction around E006
pre_score_corrections: Narrow generic hidden feature-token rejection to hidden TVT/target/label fields; legal hidden-row geometry and GR missingness remain allowed.
Replace repeated OOF/train-file parsing with deterministic hash-sealed sufficient statistics; model semantics and gates unchanged.

conclusion: Pre-registered from verified E010 outputs and a frozen representation-capacity audit. Two pre-score execution/schema corrections are recorded: legal suffix geometry remains allowed, and repeated row/file parsing is replaced by a deterministic compact sufficient-statistics artifact. No learned E011 hidden-label score has been computed.
hypothesis: Split-local prediction of 3–7 nonlinear correction coefficients or spline control points can recover materially more of E010 candidate coverage than flat candidate ranking, while remaining memory-safe and reverting exactly to E006 when confidence is weak.
